GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.1 (26 Dec 45) GS
(SCAPIN-500)
26 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Election of Members of the Lower House of the Diet in areas where Navigation of Vessels is Prohibited.
1. In reply to your CLO 401, 29 October 1945 you are advised that deliveries of election materials may be made only to the islets in Oshima-gun of Kagoshima Prefecture north of 30° north latitude excluding Kuchinoshima. No deliveries shall be made in the other islands mentioned in your request.
2. You will notify this Headquarters when such deliveries are proposed to be made seven days in advance of the time such delivery is to be made.
3. You will give appropriate advance public notice of the times when deliveries are to be made. Provisions will be made so that all candidates and political parties interested in the election will have equal opportunity to use the facilities for delivery to and communication with such islands.
4. Neither the granting nor withholding of permission requested in your CLO 401, 29 October 1945 will be interpreted as an indication of Allied policy with regard to the ultimate disposition of such islands.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN
Colonel,A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
